dimensions.evidence: The stable base and optional wrapper use actual nested typed objects, with the frozen base as first member. Major2, minimum size and feature masks admit an extension; the old ABI1 export remains a separately exact-size object. Same Linux x86-64 ABI is required.

A live feature holds pointers into its module plus the stable DSLoaded owner, and up to32 description staging bytes per call. Module mappings, loader internal allocations and relocation tables are additional resources.
Each acquired feature owns one of four real DSLoaded borrows. Release clears its descriptor before releasing the borrow; copying the active descriptor would duplicate the obligation and is forbidden.

Typed callbacks consume read-only descriptor tables. Apply/description outputs stage until success. Distinct destination/control storage and nonreentrant trusted callbacks are required; output count checks cannot prevent an arbitrary prior overwrite.
Feature operations allocate no mechanism heap. dlopen/dlclose can allocate and execute initialization; the ten original constructors increment the host counter even for rejected objects.

At most32 described octets are staged and then copied; feature acquisition publishes a small typed descriptor. No arbitrary object is moved by byte copy and no shared-library representation is serialized.
Logical close waits for all borrows. An observed successful dlclose is ownership release, not proof that every mapping vanished. Rejected descriptors still may have constructor effects.

Fixed typed apply plus optional typed describe functions are selected only after compatibility checks. Dynamic symbol lookup obtains a data object; no ISO-incompatible function-pointer cast is executed.

The feature API is controller-thread only. Retained callbacks have a separate queue/registration protocol in dispatch_async; ordinary feature borrow counting is not atomic or a cross-thread hazard scheme.

All10 complete original descriptor cases are checked against an independent admission matrix for two clients. Wrong required-mask and short-optional acceptance mutants fail defined semantic assertions without an invalid tail access.

Eight combinations independently compile GCC/Clang producers and two client views with GCC/Clang hosts. Exact commands, elapsed build times, dynamic symbols/dependencies, disassembly and separate stack reports are recorded; one ABI does not cover packing or calling-convention changes.

Observed O2 feature-acquire stack frames are80 bytes GCC and56 Clang; describe112/88. These exclude callbacks and loader frames. Executable size includes the full linked baseline dispatch/DOD objects and cannot be attributed solely to the feature wrapper.

ISO C provides object types and first-member conversion; GNU attributes and Linux libdl supply constructors and loading. A false extent cannot authenticate memory, and no same-process sandbox or arbitrary foreign-plugin compatibility is claimed.
